components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Lets users show and hide multiple sections of related content on one page.

components.name: Back link
components.purpose: Link that takes users back to the previous page in a transaction.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Shows where the current page sits in the site hierarchy and links to parent pages.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Lets users carry out an action, such as starting or submitting a form.

components.name: Character count
components.purpose: Textarea that tells users how many characters or words they have left.

components.name: Checkboxes
components.purpose: Lets users pick one or more options from a list, or toggle a single option.

components.name: Cookie banner
components.purpose: Asks users to accept or reject non-essential cookies.
components.notes: Page-level banner, not a modal overlay.

components.name: Date input
components.purpose: Separate day, month and year fields for entering a known date.

components.name: Details
components.purpose: A small expandable section for less important supporting information.

components.name: Error message
components.purpose: Inline message next to a field explaining what went wrong and how to fix it.

components.name: Error summary
components.purpose: Box at the top of a page listing all validation errors with links to each field.

components.name: Exit this page
components.purpose: Button that lets users quickly leave a sensitive page for a safe site.

components.name: Feedback
components.purpose: Asks users whether a page was useful and collects comments to improve it.

components.name: Fieldset
components.purpose: Groups related form inputs under a shared legend.
components.notes: Form grouping wrapper rather than a visual layout primitive.

components.name: File upload
components.purpose: Lets users choose and upload a file.

components.name: Generic header
components.purpose: Header for non-GOV.UK-branded services, showing the service or organisation name.

components.name: GOV.UK footer
components.purpose: Page footer with GOV.UK links, licence and copyright information.

components.name: GOV.UK header
components.purpose: Top bar showing users they are on GOV.UK.

components.name: Inset text
components.purpose: Indented block that differentiates a piece of content from surrounding text.

components.name: Language navigation
components.purpose: Lets users switch between languages the page is available in.

components.name: Notification banner
components.purpose: Tells users about something important or confirms a successful action.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Links to move between numbered pages or previous/next related pages.

components.name: Panel
components.purpose: Large coloured box confirming a completed transaction, often with a reference number.

components.name: Password input
components.purpose: Password field with a show/hide toggle.

components.name: Phase banner
components.purpose: Shows that a service is in alpha or beta and invites feedback.

components.name: Radios
components.purpose: Lets users pick exactly one option from a list.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Native dropdown for choosing one option; use only as a last resort.
components.notes: GOV.UK advises avoiding it where possible in favour of radios.

components.name: Service navigation
components.purpose: Shows the service name and top-level navigation links for a service.

components.name: Skip link
components.purpose: Hidden-until-focused link letting keyboard users jump to main content.

components.name: Summary list
components.purpose: Key-value rows summarising information, often with change links.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Presents data in rows and columns for comparison.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switches between related sections of content shown one at a time.

components.name: Tag
components.purpose: Short label showing the status of something.

components.name: Task list
components.purpose: List of tasks a user must complete, each with its status.
components.notes: Component version of the 'Complete multiple tasks' pattern; docs call it a new component still being tested.

components.name: Text input
components.purpose: Single-line field for short text answers.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Multi-line field for longer text answers.

components.name: Warning text
components.purpose: Highlighted text with an icon warning users about something important.

components.name: Addresses
components.purpose: How to ask for UK and international addresses (multiple fields, lookup or textarea).

components.name: Bank details
components.purpose: How to ask for account name, sort code, account and building society roll numbers.

components.name: Dates
components.purpose: How to ask for or show dates, choosing between date input and other controls.

components.name: Email addresses
components.purpose: How to ask for an email address with the right input type and validation.

components.name: Equality information
components.purpose: How to ask optional equality questions such as ethnicity, sex and disability.

components.name: Names
components.purpose: How to ask for a person's name without assuming a structure.

components.name: National Insurance numbers
components.purpose: How to ask for a National Insurance number.

components.name: Passwords
components.purpose: How to ask users to create or enter a password.

components.name: Payment card details
components.purpose: How to ask for card number, expiry date, security code and cardholder name.

components.name: Phone numbers
components.purpose: How to ask for UK and international phone numbers.

components.name: Check a service is suitable
components.purpose: Eligibility questions that tell users early whether they can use a service.

components.name: Check answers
components.purpose: A page letting users review and change their answers before submitting.
components.notes: Patterns section: 'Help users to'. Implemented with the Summary list component.

components.name: Complete multiple tasks
components.purpose: Task list page for long transactions split into several tasks.
components.notes: Patterns section: 'Help users to'. Implemented with the Task list component.

components.name: Confirm a phone number
components.purpose: Sends a security code by text to check the user has access to a phone number.

components.name: Confirm an email address
components.purpose: Sends a link or code by email to check the user can access an address.

components.name: Contact a department or service team
components.purpose: How to show contact details such as phone, email and opening hours.

components.name: Create a username
components.purpose: How to help users create a username that is unique and memorable.

components.name: Create accounts
components.purpose: When and how to ask users to create an account in a service.

components.name: Exit a page quickly
components.purpose: Using the Exit this page component so users at risk can leave a sensitive page fast.

components.name: Navigate a service
components.purpose: How to structure header and service navigation so users can move around a service.

components.name: Recover from validation errors
components.purpose: How to validate answers and show error summaries and messages.

components.name: Start using a service
components.purpose: Start page or entry point that explains a service and begins the journey.

components.name: Confirmation pages
components.purpose: Page telling users they have completed a transaction and what happens next.

components.name: Cookies page
components.purpose: Page explaining cookies with a form to accept or reject each type.

components.name: Interruption pages
components.purpose: Page that stops users mid-journey to warn them about something important.

components.name: Page not found pages
components.purpose: 404 page for when a URL does not exist.

components.name: Question pages
components.purpose: Page layout for asking users one question (or a few) at a time.

components.name: Service unavailable pages
components.purpose: Page shown when a service is closed, shut down or unavailable.

components.name: Step by step navigation
components.purpose: Numbered sequence of steps showing how to complete an end-to-end task across services.
components.notes: Patterns section: 'Pages'. Owned by GOV.UK Publishing (mainstream GOV.UK); not in govuk-frontend, docs point to GOV.UK Publishing components.

components.name: There is a problem with the service pages
components.purpose: Page shown when something has gone wrong with the service (500 error).

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.purpose: Keeps content at a fixed width-to-height ratio.

components.name: Bleed
components.purpose: Lets content break out of its parent's horizontal padding.

components.name: Box
components.purpose: Generic styled container; the base building block.

components.name: Center (Absolute)
components.purpose: Absolutely centres an element within its positioned parent.

components.name: Center
components.purpose: Centres its child horizontally and vertically.

components.name: Container
components.purpose: Constrains content to a max width with horizontal padding.

components.name: Flex
components.purpose: Box with flexbox display and shorthand props.

components.name: Float
components.purpose: Anchors an element to an edge or corner of a container, e.g. a badge.

components.name: Grid
components.purpose: Box with CSS grid display and shorthand props.

components.name: Group
components.purpose: Groups elements together, e.g. attached buttons.

components.name: Scroll Area
components.purpose: Scrollable region with custom-styled scrollbars.
components.notes: Docs sidebar group: Layout. Interactive layout helper; not marked presentational.

components.name: Separator
components.purpose: Visual divider line between content.

components.name: SimpleGrid
components.purpose: Responsive equal-width grid by column count or min child width.

components.name: Splitter
components.purpose: Resizable panels separated by draggable handles.
components.notes: Docs sidebar group: Layout. Interactive layout component; not marked presentational.

components.name: Stack
components.purpose: Stacks children vertically or horizontally with even spacing.

components.name: Wrap
components.purpose: Lays out children in a row that wraps onto new lines with gaps.

components.name: Blockquote
components.purpose: Styled quotation with optional citation.

components.name: Code
components.purpose: Inline code snippet.

components.name: Code Block
components.purpose: Multi-line code with syntax highlighting, copy and line numbers.

components.name: Em
components.purpose: Emphasised (italic) text.

components.name: Heading
components.purpose: Title text rendered as a heading element.

components.name: Highlight
components.purpose: Highlights matching words or phrases inside a text string.

components.name: Kbd
components.purpose: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: Styled anchor for navigating to another page or resource.

components.name: Link Overlay
components.purpose: Makes a whole container (e.g. card) clickable as a link while keeping nested links.

components.name: List
components.purpose: Ordered or unordered list with optional icons.

components.name: Mark
components.purpose: Marks text as highlighted for reference.

components.name: Prose
components.purpose: Applies readable typographic styles to arbitrary HTML/markdown content.

components.name: Rich Text Editor
components.purpose: WYSIWYG editor for formatted text.

components.name: Text
components.purpose: Renders paragraphs and inline text.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Triggers an action or event.

components.name: Close Button
components.purpose: Icon button that closes a dialog, drawer or similar.

components.name: Icon Button
components.purpose: Button showing only an icon.

components.name: Download Trigger
components.purpose: Button that downloads a file or blob when clicked.

components.name: Date Input
components.purpose: Typed date field with segmented day/month/year entry.
components.notes: Docs sidebar group: Date and Time.

components.name: Date Picker
components.purpose: Input with a popup calendar for choosing a date or range.
components.notes: Docs sidebar group: Date and Time.

components.name: Calendar
components.purpose: Inline calendar grid for picking dates.
components.notes: Docs sidebar group: Date and Time.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Lets users select one or more options.

components.name: Checkbox Card
components.purpose: Card-styled checkbox with title and description.

components.name: Color Picker
components.purpose: Lets users choose a colour via area, sliders, swatches or input.

components.name: Color Swatch
components.purpose: Displays a colour sample.

components.name: Editable
components.purpose: Text that turns into an input when clicked for in-place editing.

components.name: Field
components.purpose: Wraps a form control with label, helper text and error text.
components.notes: Docs sidebar group: Forms. Form wrapper, categorised as layout.

components.name: Fieldset
components.purpose: Groups related form fields under a legend.

components.name: File Upload
components.purpose: Lets users select or drag-and-drop files to upload.

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Single-line text field.

components.name: Number Input
components.purpose: Numeric field with increment/decrement controls.

components.name: Password Input
components.purpose: Password field with visibility toggle and optional strength meter.

components.name: Pin Input
components.purpose: Row of single-character boxes for codes or PINs.

components.name: Radio Card
components.purpose: Card-styled radio for choosing one option with extra detail.

components.name: Radio
components.purpose: Lets users pick exactly one option from a set.

components.name: Rating
components.purpose: Star (or icon) rating control.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.purpose: Row of mutually exclusive segments for picking one option.

components.name: Select (Native)
components.purpose: Browser-native dropdown select.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: On/off toggle.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Pick a value or range by dragging a thumb along a track.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Multi-line text field.

components.name: Tags Input
components.purpose: Field for entering multiple values as removable tags.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: Text input with a filterable dropdown of options.

components.name: Listbox
components.purpose: Inline list of selectable options.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Custom dropdown for choosing one or more options.

components.name: Tree View
components.purpose: Hierarchical, expandable tree of items.
components.notes: Docs sidebar group: Collections. Listed under Collections; also selectable/expandable.

components.name: Action Bar
components.purpose: Floating bar of actions shown when items are selected.

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: Modal window over the page requiring user attention.

components.name: Drawer
components.purpose: Panel that slides in from a screen edge.

components.name: Floating Panel
components.purpose: Draggable, resizable non-modal panel.

components.name: Hover Card
components.purpose: Preview card shown when hovering over a link.

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: Dropdown list of actions or options.

components.name: Overlay Manager
components.purpose: Programmatic API for opening and managing overlays such as dialogs.

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Non-modal floating content anchored to a trigger.

components.name: Toggle Tip
components.purpose: Tooltip-like info bubble opened by click, for touch and screen readers.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Short label shown on hover or focus.

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Stack of collapsible sections.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.purpose: Trail of links showing the current page's location.

components.name: Carousel
components.purpose: Slideshow for cycling through items or images.

components.name: Collapsible
components.purpose: Shows and hides a single region of content.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Controls for moving between pages of content.

components.name: Steps
components.purpose: Shows progress through a multi-step process.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switches between related panels of content.

components.name: Alert
components.purpose: Inline message conveying status such as info, success, warning or error.

components.name: Empty State
components.purpose: Placeholder shown when there is no data to display.

components.name: Progress Circle
components.purpose: Circular indicator of task progress.

components.name: Progress
components.purpose: Linear bar indicating task progress.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Placeholder shapes shown while content loads.

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: Animated indicator that something is loading.

components.name: Status
components.purpose: Small coloured dot and label showing a state.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Temporary notification that appears and disappears on its own.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Picture or initials representing a user.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Small label to highlight status or a count.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Container grouping related content and actions.

components.name: Clipboard
components.purpose: Copies a value to the clipboard with feedback.

components.name: Image
components.purpose: Displays an image.

components.name: Data List
components.purpose: List of label-value pairs.

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Renders an SVG icon.

components.name: Marquee
components.purpose: Continuously scrolling strip of content.

components.name: QR Code
components.purpose: Generates and displays a QR code.

components.name: Stat
components.purpose: Shows a key metric with label and change indicator.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Presents data in rows and columns.

components.name: Tag
components.purpose: Label for categorising items, optionally closable.

components.name: Timeline
components.purpose: Chronological list of events.

components.name: LocaleProvider
components.purpose: Sets locale and text direction for descendant components.

components.name: FormatNumber
components.purpose: Formats numbers, currency and percentages for a locale.

components.name: FormatByte
components.purpose: Formats byte sizes into human-readable units.

components.name: Checkmark
components.purpose: Standalone check indicator for building custom checkbox UIs.

components.name: ClientOnly
components.purpose: Renders children only on the client, not during SSR.

components.name: EnvironmentProvider
components.purpose: Supplies the root node/document for iframes and shadow DOM.

components.name: For
components.purpose: Declarative loop that renders a list from an array.

components.name: Presence
components.purpose: Handles mount/unmount animations for conditional content.

components.name: Portal
components.purpose: Renders children into a different part of the DOM.

components.name: Radiomark
components.purpose: Standalone radio indicator for building custom radio UIs.

components.name: Show
components.purpose: Conditionally renders children based on a boolean.

components.name: Skip Nav
components.purpose: Link that lets keyboard users skip to main content.

components.name: Visually Hidden
components.purpose: Hides content visually while keeping it available to screen readers.

components.name: Theme
components.purpose: Applies a different colour mode/theme to a subtree.
